# Shed Building Permit

> Shed Building Permit (part of GetMyPermit) prepares and lodges building permit applications for sheds, garages and outbuildings in Perth and Western Australia.

## Pages

- [Shed building permits in Perth, done for you.](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/): Need a shed building permit in Perth or WA? We check your council's rules, draw the site plan and lodge your application. Fixed price, no runaround.
- [Do I need a permit for a shed in WA?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/do-i-need-a-permit-for-a-shed): In WA a freestanding shed of 10 m² or less and 2.4 m tall or less usually doesn't need a building permit. Here is how to measure, and the rules that still apply.
- [Garage building permits in WA](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/garage-building-permit): Every garage in WA needs a building permit, and many need planning approval too. What triggers it, how garages differ from carports and sheds, and how we handle it.
- [Retrospective shed approval in WA](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/retrospective-shed-approval): Shed built without a permit? How retrospective approval works in WA, what the surveyor checks, common problems with older sheds, and how we handle it for you.
- [Do I need council approval for a garden shed?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/garden-shed-approval): Do you need council approval for a garden shed in Perth? Usually not if it's freestanding, 10 m² or less and 2.4 m high. The planning rules that still apply.
- [What a Perth shed really costs, approvals included](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-cost-perth): What a shed costs in Perth in 2026: advertised kit and installed prices, a cost breakdown, and the real council fees, levy and extras for approval.
- [Kit shed vs custom shed: who handles the permit?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/kit-shed-vs-custom-shed): Kit shed or custom-built shed in WA: the permit rules are the same. Who supplies the engineering, site plan and application, and what councils ask for.
- [How to draw a shed site plan for council](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-site-plan): How to draw a shed site plan for a WA council: what to show (boundaries, setbacks, levels, easements), the right scale, and a step-by-step guide.
- [City of Swan shed rules](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/city-of-swan-shed-rules): City of Swan shed rules: when you need a building permit, house block size limits, rural and Swan Valley shed exemptions up to 300 m², and timeframes.
- [Can you build a shed over a sewer or easement?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-over-sewer-or-easement): Building a shed near a sewer or easement in Perth: how to find the pipe, Water Corporation clearance distances, piles, and how it affects your permit.
- [Do you need a permit for a sea container in Perth?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/sea-container-permit-perth): Sea container approval in Perth: council container policies, Cockburn vs Wanneroo rules, time limits, conditions, and when a building permit is needed.
- [What happens if you build a shed without approval?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-without-approval): Built a shed without a permit in WA? The penalties, your three options, how retrospective approval with a BA13 and BA18 works, and what it costs.
- [Shed permit cost in WA (2026)](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-permit-cost-wa): What a shed building permit costs in WA in 2026: the 0.32% BA2 fee, the Building Services Levy, worked examples, verge bonds, planning fees and when a shed is free.
- [Shed vs garage: what approvals each needs](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-vs-garage): Shed vs garage approvals in WA: building permits, outbuilding size and height limits, garage street setbacks and boundary walls, and the $50,000 registered builder threshold.
- [How to get a shed permit in WA](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/how-to-get-a-shed-permit): How to get a shed building permit in WA in six steps: exemptions, planning rules, drawings, the BA2 form, fees, the 25 business day wait and the BA7 notice.
- [City of Wanneroo shed rules](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/city-of-wanneroo-shed-rules): City of Wanneroo shed rules: no permit up to 10 m² and 2.4 m, the small and large outbuilding standards, 1 m setbacks, fire separation, verge bonds and what to lodge.
- [Can I put a toilet or shower in my shed?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/toilet-or-shower-in-a-shed): You can usually add a toilet or shower to a shed in WA if a licensed plumber does it and nobody lives in it. Permits, septic, and when a shed becomes a dwelling.
- [Shed size checker: permit or no permit?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-size-checker): Free WA shed size checker. Enter length, width, height and lot size to see if your shed needs a building permit or planning approval, and the setback from the fence.
- [How close can a shed be to the fence in WA?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/how-close-can-a-shed-be-to-the-fence): Under WA's standard rules a shed wall up to 9 m long sits 1 m from a side or rear fence. When it can go closer or on the boundary, and what needs planning approval.
- [Guides](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to sheds and garages approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
